from roman import from_roman, validate_roman

    assert validate_roman(s) is False, repr(s)

        from_roman(s)

        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("from_roman must raise ValueError for %r" % (s,))
good = ["xiv", "Xiv", "mmmcmxcix", "XIV", "MMMM", "mmmm", "MMMMCMXCIX", "MMMMD", "MMMCMXCIX"]
for s in good:
    assert validate_roman(s) is True, repr(s)
    from_roman(s)
print("validate_roman / from_roman consistency OK")
